name: Full Moon Romance
review:
Full Moon Romance is a 15-line werewolf drive-in slot with Jack and Rosie, featuring wilds, scatters, a clone feature and free spins.

Thunderkick rates it Medium volatility, with a 1,005x cap and a 96.1% RTP.

The clone feature copies symbols to help line up wins, and the free spins bonus is the main event. With a cap of about 1,000x, it's a gentle game for relaxed sessions.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
